sops.title: Daily Outlet Opening & Closing Audit
steps: Check kitchen hygiene & chiller temperatures (below 4°C)
Verify POS cash float & staff grooming checklist
Review daily sales target & KDS speed with Shift Manager

mcqs.q: Chiller ka ideal temperature kya hona chahiye?

sops.title: POS Billing & Cash Drawer Reconciliation
steps: Count opening cash float before first bill
Verify UPI payment alert before closing QR order
Tally Z-Report with physical cash & card slips

mcqs.q: QR UPI order accept karne se pehle kya check karein?

sops.title: Sweet Counter Display & Hygiene SOP
steps: Wipe glass counter with food-grade sanitizer
Arrange fresh trays using FIFO (First-In, First-Out)
Always wear gloves & hairnet while packing sweets

mcqs.q: Mithai counter par kaun sa rule follow hota hai?

sops.title: Chaat Counter Prep & Crispness SOP
steps: Check freshness & cold temperature of curd and chutneys
Keep puris in airtight moisture-free containers
Assemble chaat only after KOT arrives so it stays crispy

mcqs.q: Chaat assemble kab karni chahiye?
opts: KOT order aane ke turant baad

sops.title: 30-Minute Dining & Washroom Sanitization
steps: Sanitize dining tables immediately after guest leaves
Check and clean guest washrooms every 30 minutes
Keep wet-floor caution sign during mopping

mcqs.q: Guest washroom ki safai kitni der mein check honi chahiye?

sops.title: 3-Minute Guest Greeting & Table Service
steps: Greet guest with smile & serve water within 3 minutes
Repeat order clearly before punching or serving
Clear empty plates within 2 minutes of meal completion

mcqs.q: Guest baithne ke kitni der mein water & greeting honi chahiye?

sops.title: Floor Management & Upselling SOP
steps: Assign tables evenly and monitor peak hour waiting
Suggest signature dishes, sweets or shakes while taking order
Verify KDS ready alerts and ensure hot food delivery

mcqs.q: Order lete samay Captain ko kya suggest karna chahiye?

sops.title: Peak Hour KDS & Floor Handover SOP
steps: Conduct 10-minute pre-shift briefing with all staff
Monitor KDS ticket timer (target under 12 mins)
Log pending maintenance or stock shortage in handover book

mcqs.q: KDS par average order preparation target kitna hona chahiye?

sops.title: Standardized Recipe & Zero-Wastage SOP
steps: Follow exact gram & spoon measurements from Recipe Book
Check garnish and plate rim cleanliness before pass
Record any spoilage or wastage in kitchen log

mcqs.q: Har outlet par same taste rakhne ke liye kya zaroori hai?
opts: Exact gram aur spoon size follow karna

sops.title: Vegetable Prep & Dishwashing Sanitization
steps: Wash vegetables in food-grade chlorine/salt water
Follow 3-sink dishwashing (Wash -> Rinse -> Sanitize)
Empty kitchen dustbins whenever 75% full

mcqs.q: Kitchen dustbin kab khali karna chahiye?

sops.title: Attendance, Compliance & License Audit
steps: Verify biometric/app punch-in and shift roster daily
Track FSSAI, Fire Safety, and Pest Control renewal dates
Maintain updated KYC & employee files

mcqs.q: Staff attendance kab verify honi chahiye?

sops.title: Daily Sales & Expense Reconciliation
steps: Match POS net sales with Bank UPI/Card settlements
Verify petty cash vouchers with physical bills
Generate monthly payroll & advance deductions

mcqs.q: POS UPI/Card sales ko kisse match kiya jata hai?

sops.title: FIFO Stock Issue & Expiry Control SOP
steps: Weigh and check quality of every incoming vendor delivery
Label all dry & cold items with receiving & expiry date
Issue older batch stock first (FIFO)

mcqs.q: Vendor se maal aane par sabse pehle kya karein?

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
steps: Heat tawa to 200°C and sprinkle light water.
Pour 1 full ladle (120ml) batter and spread thin.
Add 1 Table Spoon ghee, 2 scoops masala in center and fold crisp.

mcqs.q: 1 Masala Dosa ke liye kitna batter ladle use hota hai?

recipes.name: Paneer Dosa
steps: Spread 120ml batter on medium-hot tawa.
Top with grated paneer, onion, capsicum and roast golden brown.

mcqs.q: Paneer Dosa mein kitna grated paneer dalta hai?

recipes.name: Pyaz (Onion) Dosa
steps: Sprinkle chopped onion and coriander on hot tawa.
Pour 1 ladle batter over onions and roast crisp.

mcqs.q: Pyaz Dosa mein kitna chopped onion padta hai?

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Simmer 2 ladles makhani gravy with butter for 3 minutes.
Add 12 paneer cubes, kasuri methi and fresh cream.

mcqs.q: Paneer Butter Masala ke 1 full portion mein kitne paneer cubes hote hain?

recipes.name: Margherita Thin Crust Pizza
steps: Spread 60gm pizza sauce leaving 1cm border.
Top with 110gm mozzarella cheese and bake at 260°C for 6-7 mins.

mcqs.q: 10-inch Pizza par kitni Mozzarella cheese padti hai?

recipes.name: Crisp Aloo Tikki Chaat
steps: Crisp fry 2 tikkis on tawa until golden brown.
Pour 1 ladle curd, 2 tbsp sweet chutney, 2 tbsp green chutney and sev.

mcqs.q: 1 Plate Aloo Tikki Chaat mein kitni tikkis hoti hain?

recipes.name: Thick Cafe Cold Coffee
steps: Blend milk, coffee, sugar and ice cubes for 35 seconds until frothy.
Top with 1 full scoop vanilla ice cream.

mcqs.q: Thick Cold Coffee mein kitna Vanilla Ice Cream dalta hai?

recipes.name: Pure Desi Ghee Motichoor Ladoo
steps: Fry micro boondi in pure desi ghee on medium heat.
Soak in warm 1-thread sugar syrup and shape 45gm uniform ladoos.

mcqs.q: 1 Kg mein kitne standard Motichoor Ladoo bante hain?

recipes.name: Kesar Rasmalai
steps: Boil chhena discs in light sugar syrup for 12 mins.
Soak in chilled kesar-pista rabri for 3 hours before serving.

mcqs.q: 1 Portion Rasmalai mein kitni rabri aur pieces serve hote hain?

recipes.name: Ajmeri Kalakand
steps: Roast khoya and moist chhena on low-medium flame.
Set in greased tray 1.2-inch thick and cut into squares.

mcqs.q: Kalakand ko tray mein kitna mota (thick) set kiya jata hai?

recipes.name: Royal Kaju Katli
steps: Cook sieved cashew powder in 1-thread sugar syrup until dough leaves pan.
Roll to 4mm uniform thickness and cut into diamond shapes.

mcqs.q: Royal Kaju Katli ko kitna patla roll kiya jata hai?
